verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Spend AI docs say AI captures receipts and matches them to card transactions without employee input. They also say it handles partial, split, and timing-mismatched receipts, and that missing receipts are flagged before approval. Nothing shows e-receipts being pulled automatically from integrations, and the missing-receipt flagging is not documented as a targeted employee nudge. Missing for 10: e-receipt ingestion from integrations, an explicit employee nudge sent only for genuinely missing receipts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an employee, receipts match to card transactions automatically — with e-receipts pulled from integrations — and I get nudged only when one is genuinely missing

citations.quote: AI captures receipts and matches them to the right card transactions without manual input from employees.
AI handles partial receipts, split transactions, and timing mismatches so expenses don’t get stuck.
Missing, unclear, or invalid receipts are flagged before they reach approval, reducing rework later.
